Invented fixture text in the layout of Law No. (26) of 2007
Every word below is invented. It copies the layout of the Dubai Legislation Portal's English translation (a heading above each "Article (n)", clauses numbered 1. and a.), never its text: the law itself is fetched at build time and never committed.
Title
Article (1)
This invented article gives an invented name to an invented law.
Lease Contract
Article (4)
1. An invented clause on how a lease contract is written and signed.
2. An invented clause on how a lease contract is registered.
Term of Lease Contract
Article (5)
An invented article without clauses, on an invented term.
Article (6)
An invented article that sits under the same heading as the one above it.

Termination
Article (25)
1. In these invented cases a landlord may ask for an invented eviction:
a. an invented first case;
b. an invented second case.
2. An invented clause with an invented notice of ninety (90) days.
